entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 3827873938815011200: position at J2016.0. Distance: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 47431: distance 80.71 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.011), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 80.71 +/- 0.888 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 12.9055 +/- 0.1751 mas (same row, RUWE 2.27), 73.7 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 46.270, -62.544 mas/yr. Radial velocity from SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 3827873938815011200 (quality A), from 2008AJ....135..209M; Gaia DR3 measures none.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 29.544 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 47431: radius 29.544 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 270.611 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.059) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 4310 +/- 125 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 47431: effective temperature 4310 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.066).
